name: InquiryFlow
author: WP Travel Kit

sections.description:
InquiryFlow turns trip-page visitors into booked travelers. It adds a floating “Plan My Trip” button to every WP Travel Engine trip, opens a one-tap WhatsApp chat pre-filled with the trip name, and collects every lead in a built-in inquiry inbox — right inside WordPress. No long forms, no missed messages, no coding.

Stop losing travelers who were ready to ask. InquiryFlow makes it effortless to capture inquiries the moment a visitor is interested, then manage every lead from one place.

Capture inquiries everywhere

  • Floating “Plan My Trip” button on every trip page — always visible, never missed.
  • Quick inquiry popup so visitors can send their name, email, and message in seconds.
  • One-tap WhatsApp chat with a pre-filled message that already includes the trip name, so conversations start with context.
  • “We typically reply within a few hours” reassurance text to boost trust and response rates.

Make it match your brand

  • Customizable button label, color, and shape (pill or circle).
  • Choose exactly where the button appears — trip pages, blog posts, pages.
  • Add the inquiry form anywhere with a shortcode or Gutenberg block.
  • Trip-aware: the form automatically knows which trip the visitor is viewing.

Manage every lead in one place

  • Built-in Inquiries inbox right inside WordPress — no spreadsheets.
  • Track each inquiry through clear statuses: New, Contacted, Booked, Closed.
  • See where each lead came from and search, filter, and open full details.
  • Export your leads to CSV any time for reporting or backups.
  • At-a-glance stats showing how many inquiries you’re getting over time.

Never miss a new inquiry

  • Instant email notification to your team the moment a lead comes in.
  • Send notifications to multiple recipients (sales, owner, agents).

Privacy & spam protection

  • Consent checkbox with a link to your privacy policy (GDPR-friendly).
  • Spam blocking with hCaptcha support, honeypot, and secure submissions.
  • Data retention controls so you stay in charge of stored information.

Easy setup

  • Guided onboarding that walks you through WhatsApp and notification setup.
  • Works out of the box on WP Travel Engine sites.
  • Translation-ready and compatible with WPML and Polylang.

Built for WP Travel Engine

InquiryFlow reads your real trips, destinations, and trip types automatically from WP Travel Engine, so it feels native inside your dashboard. It’s lightweight, performance-optimized, and built to stay out of the way of your page speed and SEO.

Upgrade to InquiryFlow Pro

Everything in Free, plus the tools to convert, automate, and scale:

  • Custom Trip Request Builder — a beautiful multi-step trip planner wizard (destination → dates → travellers → budget → travel style → contact) with fully customizable steps and fields, no code required.
  • Smart, travel-specific inputs — destination picker, flexible-or-exact dates, traveller counts with child ages, budget tiers, and travel-style chips with follow-up questions, all pulling real destinations and trip types from WP Travel Engine.
  • Automated follow-ups — an instant thank-you email and a delayed follow-up (you choose the timing), with personalized merge tags and one-click unsubscribe.
  • CRM sync with FluentCRM, Jetpack CRM, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Brevo, ActiveCampaign, ConvertKit, Zoho CRM, and Klaviyo — with auto-tagging, phone sync, and automatic retry.
  • Exit-intent popup to recover inquiries before a visitor leaves.
  • Conversion tracking & advanced analytics that tie real bookings back to the inquiries that started them, with breakdowns by channel, destination, and trip.
  • Google reCAPTCHA for stronger spam protection on busy sites.
  • Developer hooks & filters so agencies can tailor InquiryFlow Pro to any workflow.

Learn more about InquiryFlow Pro »

InquiryFlow is part of WP Travel Kit — the toolkit travel businesses install to get more bookings from their WP Travel Engine websites.

External services

This plugin can connect to third-party services when specific features are enabled by the site administrator. No data is sent to these services unless the feature is turned on and used as described below.

hCaptcha (optional spam protection)

Used to verify inquiry form submissions and reduce spam when the site owner enables hCaptcha in InquiryFlow settings and provides hCaptcha site and secret keys.

  • When the inquiry widget or form is shown with hCaptcha enabled, the visitor’s browser loads the hCaptcha JavaScript from hCaptcha.
  • When a visitor submits an inquiry, the plugin sends the hCaptcha response token and the site owner’s secret key to hCaptcha’s verification API to confirm the challenge was completed.

Service provided by Intuition Machines, Inc. (hCaptcha): terms of service, privacy policy.

Google reCAPTCHA (optional; requires InquiryFlow Pro)

Used for stronger spam protection when the site owner has InquiryFlow Pro, selects Google reCAPTCHA in settings, and provides reCAPTCHA site and secret keys.

  • When enabled, the visitor’s browser loads the Google reCAPTCHA JavaScript from Google.
  • When a visitor submits a protected form, InquiryFlow Pro sends the reCAPTCHA response token and the site owner’s secret key to Google’s verification API.

Service provided by Google LLC: terms of service, privacy policy.

WhatsApp (optional visitor chat)

Used when the site owner enables the WhatsApp option and a visitor chooses to open a WhatsApp chat from the inquiry widget.

  • When the visitor clicks the WhatsApp button, their browser is opened to WhatsApp’s wa.me link with the site owner’s configured phone number and a pre-filled message (which may include the trip name). No data is sent to WhatsApp until the visitor takes that action.

Service provided by WhatsApp LLC / Meta: terms of service, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the inquiryflow folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress Plugins → Add New screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WP Travel Engine is installed and active — InquiryFlow extends it.
  4. Go to InquiryFlow → Settings and follow the guided onboarding to add your WhatsApp number and notification recipients.
  5. Choose where the floating “Plan My Trip” button appears, and you’re capturing inquiries.
sections.faq:
Do I need WP Travel Engine to use this plugin?

Yes. InquiryFlow is built to extend WP Travel Engine — it reads your trips, destinations, and trip types automatically, so it won’t work without it.

What’s the difference between Free and Pro?

Free gives you the floating “Plan My Trip” button, quick inquiry popup, one-tap WhatsApp chat, and a built-in inquiry inbox. Pro adds the custom multi-step trip request builder, automated thank-you and follow-up emails, CRM sync with nine platforms, exit-intent recovery, and conversion analytics.

Do I need a WhatsApp Business account?

No. The one-tap WhatsApp chat works with any WhatsApp number. Add yours during onboarding and visitors can message you with the trip name already filled in.

Where does the inquiry button appear?

You choose. Show it on trip pages, blog posts, and pages, or place the form anywhere with a shortcode or Gutenberg block. The form is trip-aware, so it always knows which trip the visitor is viewing.

Where do my inquiries go?

Every lead lands in the built-in Inquiries inbox inside WordPress, where you can track status (New, Contacted, Booked, Closed), search and filter, add notes, and export to CSV. You also get an instant email notification for each new inquiry.

Will it slow down my site?

No. InquiryFlow is lightweight and performance-optimized, so it won’t drag down your page speed or SEO.

Is it translation-ready?

Yes. InquiryFlow works with WPML, Polylang, and other translation plugins, and all front-end labels are customizable.

Can I customize the trip request form?

The multi-step Custom Trip Request Builder is a Pro feature. With Pro you can turn steps on or off, reorder them, rename labels, and add your own custom questions — all without code.

Which CRMs does it connect to?

CRM sync is a Pro feature. InquiryFlow Pro pushes leads to FluentCRM, Jetpack CRM, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Brevo, ActiveCampaign, ConvertKit, Zoho CRM, and Klaviyo, with auto-tagging and automatic retry.
